# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

body:
Require local disclosure fields and preserve explicit original vantage

Related to #1816. Address both post-merge findings on #1891.

The signature example now states the original claim vantage explicitly, independently of its signer. DisclosureDecision has class-local allValuesFrom and qualified maximum-one restrictions for Agent readers and DisclosureOutcome results. Class-scoped ClosureEntry records make both paths required in the validation projection; a bare open-world existential is not substituted for presence. Ordinary observation results remain multivalued and separate decision nodes retain different readers or policy versions. Principles 4, 7, 9, 12 and 17.

The authenticated fixture producer already selects the observations module. A new read-only consumer checks its actual typed shape and nine small boundary cases: complete, absent fields, duplicate fields, wrong value types, unrelated multivalued observations and separate complete decisions. It hydrates retained producer output and never compiles source modules or generates corpus shapes. No new term, catalog change, dependency, detector exemption, ratchet, profile or gate is introduced.

All four focused synthetic lowering tests passed, covering required paths, qualified counts and no global closure leakage. Strict producer-independent Clippy passed with warnings denied and compiled the real new consumer. Source audit, diff hygiene and all normal signed commit hooks passed, including corpus-purity, formatting, Markdown and spelling. The corpus-backed nine-case consumer itself has NOT executed locally. No local optimized producer, corpus construction, synchronization or full gate ran; complete generated and corpus acceptance remain unverified.

The user instructed: "merge them one by one, ignoring CI." Pending checks do not delay integration and are not called passes. Current review submissions, inline comments and threads are captured before merging; a processing notice is not approval. Independent local review is unavailable and local source/requirements review is self-assessment. The fetched base has no additional source delta and merge-tree produced a clean candidate with no conflicts.

The authoritative plan is .stage/identity-vantage-and-policy-address/plan.md and the selected Stage directory is .stage/identity-vantage-and-policy-address. After landing, verify the actual tree and archive, reply to both original findings and resolve their threads, then remove only this completed owned branch/worktree and fast-forward main. Preserve the unfinished GMN sibling. The complete portfolio remains active at .stage/queues/all-issues/queue.md.
